name: Top Working Program
benefit: - **Training Benefit:** Provision of 20-day training on top working techniques to rural unemployed youth. - **Tool Kit Distribution:** Each trainee is provided with a tool kit worth up to ₹400/- during the training period. - **Financial Incentive for Successful Grafting:** A payment of ₹10/- per successfully grafted tree is provided once the branches reach approximately 2 feet in length.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must belong to rural area. - The applicant must be an unemployed youth.
